title: Add an explicit declined-payment outcome
requirement: Treat payment method declined as a recognized authorization failure rather than an unknown method. Introduce checkout.ErrPaymentDeclined as a distinct error sentinel, return it from authorization and map it using errors.Is to HTTP 402 with exact body payment declined. Card/bank authorization and unknown methods retain their behavior. Inventory and pricing validation happen before authorization, so earlier invalid inputs retain priority. Preserve all unrelated behavior and public APIs. This sentinel is the Go mapping of the Kiro typed PaymentDeclined outcome.
scope: One independent change to the supplied baseline; implement and verify without a human review gate.
acceptance: Behavior is checked through HTTP against the task and unchanged baseline contracts. Payment-boundary additionally has an explicit structural check. Add or update meaningful public tests.
limits: Do not change AGENTS.md, task.json or the Go module identity. Use the declared isolated tool environment. Add meaningful tests; implement, audit and verify without waiting for human source review.
